class.name: panthera_ros2_control/PantheraHardwareInterface
class.description: Panthera-HT hardware interface driven by motor_cpp (one hightorque_robot::robot). Single arm uses 7 motors; dual arm uses 14. Motor count comes from YAML + joint layout. full_control exports position/velocity/effort/kp/kd for OCS2 MIX; also supports pd_control and position_velocity.
